item.title: Palma Miami Beach Ground Breaking
item.description: Miami, FL - December 16, 2025 - Lefferts marked a major milestone in North Beach with the groundbreaking of PALMA Miami Beach Residences, its newest luxury condominium project. Miami Beach joined Lefferts leadership for remarks, followed by a live performance from singer-songwriter Maya Azucena. Designed by Built Form, the 14-story, 126-residence development is the second project in Lefferts’ three-phase plan helping drive NoBe’s continued resurgence. item.title: WRE News: Pilates Dominates Miami’s Fitness Scene in 2025
item.description: Miami, FL - December 17, 2025 - Miami is stretching its way to the top, with Pilates officially crowned the city’s favorite workout of 2025. According to new data from ClassPass shared with Axios, Pilates is not only Miami’s most-booked fitness class this year but also the top workout nationwide for the third year in a row, with reservations jumping 66% year over year. item.description: Miami, FL - December 18, 2025 - A bold new proposal could transform one of West Brickell’s last undeveloped sites into one of Miami’s most densely packed residential towers. item.title: WRE News: Miami Beach Approves $500 Surplus Checks for Homeowners
item.description: Miami, FL - December 19, 2025 - Miami Beach city commissioners voted unanimously to distribute $500 payments to more than 14,000 homesteaded homeowners using surplus budget funds, approving up to $7 million in relief tied to primary residences. While details on timing and distribution are still pending, supporters framed the move as a way to return excess taxpayer money directly to residents, marking the city’s first surplus payout in nearly two decades.
